messages:
ben: Heads-up 10AM PT demo with NovaCap (risk ops). Request: hosted ephemeral API key + temporary rate increase for a 90min POC on 2026-05-03. Need IP lock + region eu-central.

tara: What qps are they asking for? Sync vs streaming? And do they need model pinning?

ben: They want 120 qps steady for the session, with a short 10-min spike to 350 qps during load test. Mostly sync calls, a few streaming sessions. Prefer model pin to rwd-medium (latency-sensitive).

leo: Default scoped keys are 50 qps. For 120 we need a temporary quota exception. I'll need the exact window and a contact. Also: compliance asked for EU data residency and no external logging of prompts.

ops-bot: INF ticket INF-4501 opened: temporary qps exception request (120 sustained / 350 spike).

ben: Window: 2026-05-03T09:30Z-11:00Z (90m). POC lead: emma@novacap.com. On-call: tara (platform). Confirmed EU region eu-central, streaming allowed but limited.

leo: Good. I'll provision a scoped ephemeral key: ttl=4h, region=eu-central, sustained=120, spike=350 (10m). IP allowlist preferred: please provide IPs or CIDR.

emma: Sending CIDR now: 203.0.113.0/27 and 198.51.100.64/28. Also request that logs be tagged "novacap-poc" and scrubbed for account numbers.

infra: We can do that. We'll enable PII redaction flag and set logs retention to 7d for the POC. Note: full redaction can't guarantee derived embeddings stored elsewhere; we'll add a note in the SOW.

leo: Cost estimate: incremental infra reserve ~= $320 for the reserved headroom and spike buffer. Consent?

tara: Approve on cost. Two additional asks: 1) enforce token cap per request (2k tokens), 2) enable automatic fallback to rwd-small if latency > 700ms for more than 3m.

ben: OK to both. Can we also increase the streaming heartbeat to 60s so their long streams don't time out?

qa-bot: Pre-demo automated smoke scheduled at 09:00Z. Tests: open/close stream, 50 qps ramp up, spike to 200 qps for 2m.

leo: Created ephemeral key: rk_poc_novacap_2102468100 (TTL 4h). Policy: sustained=120, spike=350(10m), IP allowlist=203.0.113.0/27,198.51.100.64/28, region=eu-central, model_pin=rwd-medium. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/keys/rk_poc_novacap_2102468100

emma: Got it, testing now. One security question: will the ephemeral key be scoped to not allow model uploads or workspace reads?

leo: Yes. Scoped keys are write-limited to inference only; no admin scopes.

infra: Note: we will also put a per-token billing cap and email alert at 75% of the reserve spend.

ben: Please confirm cleanup and revoke time. We want keys revoked and pool deallocated 2h after the end.

ops-bot: INF-4501 updated: scheduled cleanup at 2026-05-03T13:00Z.

leo: Ran the smoke 30m before window from our canary nodes. Observed 140 qps headroom ok, spike to 350 hit burst throttle once for 12s then recovered. Set adaptive fallback rule: if sustained throttle >2m, switch to rwd-small.

emma: Verified integration and streaming heartbeat. Thanks! Will run demo at 09:30Z.

ben: After the demo we'll request a short summary of token usage and any anomalous errors for the SOW. @emma please send report.

emma: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
